newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia to sell $88.56 mln in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia to sell $88.56 mln in T-bills.

text.p: The National Bank of Ethiopia (central bank) on Thursday tendered for sale 28-, 91- and 182-day T-bills valued at 570 million birr ($88.56 million) -- to be issued on January 15, 1997.
The amounts tendered were 170 million birr in 28-day bills maturing on February 12; 300 million birr in 91-day bills maturing on April 16 and 100 million birr in 182-day bills maturing on July 16.
On December 18 last year, the central bank issued the same categories of bills valued at 400 million birr ($62.15 million). It did not sayb what interest rate it offered for the various categories.
